title: Fail closed and revalidate all persisted trust bindings on load
description: SECURITY: python/src/lichen/crypto/key_persistence.py::TrustStorePersistence.load returns None for malformed/unreadable existing trust_store.json, which is indistinguishable from first boot and can silently reset TOFU pins/re-enable auto-pinning. It also inserts serialized TrustEntry fields directly without verifying exact types, pubkey->IID/native-address derivation, trust level bounds, duplicate IIDs, timestamp/metadata bounds, or revoked state shape. Corruption or storage tampering can therefore erase or forge trust state. Distinguish missing from corrupt/unavailable, raise a persistence error fail-closed, fully validate and derive binding fields from pubkey, cap entries/metadata, and add corrupt/substitution/duplicate/rollback tests.
